home.metaDescription: Jaeung Kim, a web engineer in Seoul.
paragraphs: I'm a web engineer based in Seoul. When I'm not working, I'm usually on a basketball court, out with friends, or planning my next trip, with Olivia Dean on in the background.
At work I sweat the small stuff, probably more than I should. Once I spot a bug, I can't let it go until it's fixed.
This site is a bit of both: a place to try out whatever I'm curious about, and to keep photos from my trips.

resume.metaDescription: Resume of Jaeung Kim, a web engineer in Seoul: experience, projects, and education.
resume.name: Jaeung (Jae) Kim
intro: Hi, I'm Jaeung Kim, a web developer with five years of experience. I'm currently building an AI ontology platform for automotive R&D, where users ask questions in natural language and trace each answer to its source.
As a frontend developer, I work with designers and backend engineers from planning onward, turning complex requirements into something simple everyone can align on.
I write code that teammates and AI tools can read at a glance, and set up AI workflows the whole team can use.

e8ight.role: Senior Software Engineer | Platform Development Team
e8ight.platformHeading: Frontend platform and AI Native engineering
platformBullets: Consolidated every product's frontend into one monorepo with shared config and dependencies, so new products start on domain work from day one
Replaced the legacy CRA build with Vite and reworked the CI pipeline, cutting build time 80% (from 10 minutes to about 2)
Stood up Sentry on internal servers to centralize frontend error monitoring and alerting across products
Architected a design system on design tokens and shared components, and rebuilt the handoff from designers to code as an AI Native workflow
Drove the team's shift to AI Native development, designing a frontend environment around subagents scoped by role, shared rules, and skills
Introduced architecture guardrails and automated verification loops for coding agents, turning recurring failure patterns into enforceable rules

hyundai.title: Hyundai Motor R&D data integration platform
hyundai.description: Ontology knowledge graph platform for R&D data. Owned frontend architecture and development from PoC through production.
bullets: Led frontend delivery of the core product: ontology data mapping, graph visualization, and the GraphRAG streaming UI
Architected a graph visualization SDK shared across the company's GraphRAG products, with a core independent of any framework and a thin React adapter so each product plugs in its own data source

Evaluated Cytoscape.js and Sigma.js for drawing the whole graph at once, judged that dense graphs hide the relations users need, and moved to an exploration UX that starts from key nodes and expands only what users ask for
Kept d3-force for layout and wrote rendering and interaction directly on Canvas 2D, fitting nodes to the product and preserving layout on expansion so users keep their context
Decoupled the graph simulation from React through an imperative API and a Zustand store, eliminating React renders during animation
Owned release readiness in the client's secure network, covering service integrations, GitOps deployment on Harbor, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD, and SonarQube and Black Duck compliance

digitalTwin.title: Digital Twin Federation integrated portal
digitalTwin.description: Integrated portal for a national digital twin program under the Ministry of Science and ICT. Built over about two years as the sole full stack engineer on Next.js and NestJS.
bullets: Chose a rendering strategy per page (SSG, ISR, dynamic SSR, RSC), so pages behind permissions are never cached and notices stay fresh through revalidation by tag
Architected a Next.js BFF that holds tokens in HttpOnly cookies to prevent XSS token theft, with SameSite cookies and Origin checks guarding against CSRF
Unified separate auth systems across subprojects into a single shell and embedded partner research institutes' tools through iframes, coordinating integration directly with each institute
Designed RBAC with three roles and an organization model built around institutions, along with the admin console for users, notices, and boards

products.title: Company products (PMIS, NDX Cloud, and more)
products.pmisDescription: Solution for managing project schedules, resources, and drawings.
pmisBullets: Redesigned a tree of thousands of rows around lazy loading and virtual scrolling, cutting initial load from 12 seconds to 2 (about 80%)
Moved drawing uploads from serial to parallel with optimistic UI and rollback on failure, cutting 19 uploads from 4 minutes to 20 seconds
products.ndxCloudDescription: Cloud platform for managing large image datasets.
ndxCloudBullets: Abstracted four levels of permissions (organization, project, site, dataset) into a single RBAC matrix, unifying access control across every screen
Optimized EXIF extraction to parse only the JPEG APP1 marker, cutting memory for 4,000 images from 20 GB to 800 MB
Designed direct uploads from the browser to S3 with presigned URLs, halving upload time from 20 minutes to 10 and cutting server load about 70%

bullets: First and sole engineer at a clothing marketplace startup, owning stack selection, application architecture, deployment, and operations
Built a marketplace over multiple Shopify seller stores: products and orders stayed in each store, the platform owned discovery and purchase
Layered Instagram and TikTok Login Kit on Supabase Auth as the single identity provider, so social login shares one session model
Chose Shopify Payments over a custom gateway, keeping card data out of the platform while improving cart abandonment and transaction success
Owned the full stack at an EMR (electronic medical records) SaaS startup: marketing site, internal admin portal, backend API, and AWS infrastructure
Designed and shipped the WebGL (Three.js) 3D marketing site solo, from concept through deployment
Built scroll and page transition animations with GSAP and Framer Motion
Designed and ran the HR and attendance admin portal for executives without a technical background, with screens that needed no training
Built the Express backend API, MongoDB schema, AWS infrastructure, and CI/CD pipeline
Designed the React component architecture for a cryptocurrency exchange, separating shared components from screen code so new screens composed from existing pieces
Designed the credit card integration and built the crypto purchase flow from card authorization to asset credit
Fixed blank social previews for SPA links with Lambda@Edge, injecting Open Graph tags for each route at the CloudFront edge without changing how the app renders
Partnered with designers in Figma to reconcile design intent with implementation, component by component

gantt: Built and published an open source Gantt chart library for React 18 and 19 on npm, with no runtime dependencies beyond React and under 40 kB gzipped
Separated the chart's internal state from the consuming app's data ownership and isolated each instance in its own Zustand store, so every chart runs independently even on the same page
Implemented virtualization on both the row and time axes, adjusting the render range to scroll direction to keep DOM nodes to a minimum
Moved the task tree, schedule math, and dependency validation into a TypeScript core independent of React, so drag edits and hierarchy moves follow the same rules
